summary_1line: After Daksha’s sacrifice is destroyed, Shiva revives him, cosmic harmony is restored, and events are set in motion for Parvati’s birth and marriage to Shiva.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva’s attendants attach a sheep’s head to Daksha’s lifeless body while the gods watch as he awakens and bows at Shiva’s feet.
Under a vast banyan tree on Mount Kailasa, ash-covered Shiva sits in deep meditation while sages and celestial beings gather around him.
The weapons of Dadhichi and King Kshupa transform into the living forms of Shiva and Vishnu, causing both men to bow their heads in shame.
